Sea mines and underwater improvised explosive devices can threaten Canadian interests and impede maritime operations, while close-in minehunting exposes ships and personnel to avoidable risk.

Reviewer synthesis: two coastal formations can deploy modular uncrewed payloads to search, classify, identify and neutralize mine threats while keeping host vessels and crews at safer standoff distances.
